service: entermind-server # NOTE: update this with your service name

variablesResolutionMode: 20210326

custom:
  stage: dev
  settings:
    dev:
      STAGE: ${self:custom.stage}
      NODE_ENV: "develop"
    stg:
      STAGE: ${self:custom.stage}
      NODE_ENV: "staging"
    prod:
      STAGE: ${self:custom.stage}
      NODE_ENV: "production"

plugins:
  - serverless-offline

provider:
  name: aws
  region: ap-southeast-1
  runtime: nodejs18.x
  environment: ${self:custom.settings.${self:custom.stage}}
  lambdaHashingVersion: 20201221

  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: "Allow"
          Action:
            - "xray:PutTraceSegments"
            - "xray:PutTelemetryRecords"
          Resource:
            - "*"

functions:
  hello:
    handler: src/index.hello
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: get
          path: v1/hello
  getCost:
    handler: src/index.getCost
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: get
          path: v1/get-cost
  createCost:
    handler: src/index.createCost
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: post
          path: v1/create-cost
          cors:
            origin: "*"
            headers:
              - "Authorization"
              - "Content-Type"
  createRoi:
    handler: src/index.createRoi
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: post
          path: v1/create-roi
  createUsage:
    handler: src/index.createUsage
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: post
          path: v1/create-usage
  getRoi:
    handler: src/index.getRoi
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: get
          path: v1/get-roi
  getUsage:
    handler: src/index.getUsage
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: get
          path: v1/get-usage
  getTransaction:
    handler: src/index.getTransaction
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: get
          path: v1/get-transactions
  uploadFile:
    handler: src/index.uploadFile
    tracing: true
    events:
      - http:
          method: post
          path: v1/upload-file
